hebrewText: וַ/יִּרְדְּפ֨וּ חֵיל כַּשְׂדִּ֜ים אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֗ם וַ/יַּשִּׂ֣גוּ אֶת צִדְקִיָּהוּ֮ בְּ/עַֽרְב֣וֹת יְרֵחוֹ֒ וַ/יִּקְח֣וּ אֹת֗/וֹ וַֽ֠/יַּעֲלֻ/הוּ אֶל נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֧ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל רִבְלָ֖תָ/ה בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֑ת וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֖/וֹ מִשְׁפָּטִֽים

tokens.bdb: to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by)
tokens.kjv: chase, put to flight, follow (after, on), hunt, (be under) persecute(-ion, -or), pursue(-r).

tokens.bdb: probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength
tokens.kjv: able, activity, ([phrase]) army, band of men (soldiers), company, (great) forces, goods, host, might, power, riches, strength, strong, substance, train, ([phrase]) valiant(-ly), valour, virtuous(-ly), war, worthy(-ily).

tokens.bdb: a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people
tokens.kjv: Chaldeans, Chaldees, inhabitants of Chaldea.

tokens.bdb: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, [phrase] out (over) live, [phrase] persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with.

tokens.bdb: to reach (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: ability, be able, attain (unto), (be able to, can) get, lay at, put, reach, remove, wax rich, [idiom] surely, (over-) take (hold of, on, upon).

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: Tsidkijah, the name of six Israelites
tokens.kjv: Zedekiah, Zidkijah.

tokens.bdb: a desert; especially (with the article prefix) the (generally) sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea
tokens.kjv: Arabah, champaign, desert, evening, heaven, plain, wilderness. See also H1026 (בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a desert; especially  the  sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea
tokens.enLiteralWord: a desert; especially  the  sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea
tokens.explanation: a desert; especially  the  sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea
tokens.explanationEn: a desert; especially  the  sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea

tokens.bdb: Jericho or Jerecho, a place in Palestine
tokens.kjv: Jericho.

tokens.bdb: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
tokens.kjv: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

tokens.bdb: Nebukadnetstsar (or -retstsar, or -retstsor), king of Babylon
tokens.kjv: Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadrezzar.

tokens.bdb: a king
tokens.kjv: king, royal.

tokens.bdb: Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire
tokens.kjv: Babel, Babylon.

tokens.bdb: Riblah, a place in Syria
tokens.kjv: Riblah.

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.

tokens.bdb: Chamath, a place in Syria
tokens.kjv: Hamath, Hemath.

tokens.bdb: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, bid, command, commune, declare, destroy, give, name, promise, pronounce, rehearse, say, speak, be spokesman, subdue, talk, teach, tell, think, use (entreaties), utter, [idiom] well, [idiom] work.

tokens.bdb: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
tokens.kjv: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

tokens.bdb: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
tokens.kjv: [phrase] adversary, ceremony, charge, [idiom] crime, custom, desert, determination, discretion, disposing, due, fashion, form, to be judged, judgment, just(-ice, -ly), (manner of) law(-ful), manner, measure, (due) order, ordinance, right, sentence, usest, [idiom] worthy, [phrase] wrong.
